title: Song of Solomon Bible Quiz - Chapter 6
description: Ten questions on Song of Solomon 6: the beloved gone down to his garden, beautiful as Tirzah, the unique dove, and the return of the Shulammite.

questions.text: What question opens this chapter, addressed to the fairest among women?
questions.explanation: The chapter opens, "Where has your beloved gone, you fairest among women? Where has your beloved turned, that we may seek him with you?"

answers.text: "How is your beloved better than another beloved?"
"Who is this who comes up from the wilderness?"
"Why do you desire to gaze at the Shulammite?"

questions.text: Where does the speaker say her beloved has gone?
questions.explanation: She says her beloved has gone down to his garden, to the beds of spices, to pasture his flock in the gardens and to gather lilies.

answers.text: Up to the mountains of Bether
Into the streets and squares of the city
Down to his garden, to the beds of spices
Out to the tents of the shepherds

questions.text: Complete the speaker's words: "I am my beloved's, and my beloved is..."
questions.explanation: She says, "I am my beloved's, and my beloved is mine. He browses among the lilies."

questions.text: To which city is the beloved's love compared when he says she is beautiful?
questions.explanation: He says, "You are beautiful, my love, as Tirzah, lovely as Jerusalem, awesome as an army with banners."

questions.text: Why does the beloved ask her to turn away her eyes from him?
questions.explanation: He says, "Turn away your eyes from me, for they have overcome me."

answers.text: Because the queens are watching them
Because they shine like the sun
Because he must leave for his garden

questions.text: What numbers of queens and concubines does this chapter name?
questions.explanation: The verse says, "There are sixty queens, eighty concubines, and virgins without number."

answers.text: A hundred queens and a hundred concubines

questions.text: What is said about the dove, the perfect one, and her mother?
questions.explanation: The verse says, "My dove, my perfect one, is unique. She is her mother's only daughter," the favorite one of her who bore her.

answers.text: Her mother crowned her on her wedding day
Her mother made her keeper of the vineyards
Her mother is among the queens
She is her mother's only daughter

questions.text: Complete the question in verse 10: "Who is she who looks out as the morning, beautiful as the moon, clear as..."
questions.explanation: The verse asks, "Who is she who looks out as the morning, beautiful as the moon, clear as the sun, and awesome as an army with banners?"

questions.text: Why did the speaker go down into the nut tree grove?
questions.explanation: The speaker went down into the nut tree grove to see the green plants of the valley, whether the vine budded, and whether the pomegranates were in flower.

answers.text: To see whether the vine budded
To gather nuts for the feast
To hide from the daughters of Jerusalem
To rest in the shade at noon

questions.text: Who is called to return, so that the others may gaze at her?
questions.explanation: The chapter ends, "Return, return, Shulammite! Return, return, that we may gaze at you," and asks why they gaze at her as at the dance of Mahanaim.
